messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PAGER-8231 fired — auth-service.token-validator > 5% error rate for 2m. Root cause suspected: JWT signature validation failures.

pagerduty: Paging on-call: @alice (primary) @bob (secondary). Incident severity: P1.

alice: acked and joining

alice: seeing spike of 401s in metrics, auth-validator logs show 'invalid signature' and 'kid not found'

alice: curl'd our JWKS endpoint — the new key id isn't there. segfault? hmm

tim: joining from SRE

tim: paste logs

alice: ```
[2026-03-14T12:12:05Z] auth-validator ERROR jwt.verify failed: invalid signature (kid="old-key-2026-03-14")
[2026-03-14T12:12:06Z] auth-validator ERROR jwks fetch 200 OK but keyset does not contain kid="rotated-key-v2"
```

rene: from auth team — we rolled rotation at 12:00 UTC, should've published to JWKS; checking deploy

rene: rolling deploy of key-publisher failed in canary due to config typo, didn't push new key to jwks

alice: that's causing new tokens signed with rotated key to be unverifiable

leanne: support: customers reporting 401s, 14 tickets opened, top affected: AcmeCorp, BetaApps

bob: taking over (alice handing off) — alice needs a quick break

alice: handing to bob, leaving notes: rotation job id 9876, keyfile path /etc/keys/rotated-key-v2.pem, pipeline failure logs under ci/rotations/9876

bob: ack, I'm on it. plan: (1) add old key accept fallback? (2) restore jwks with rotated-key? (3) short-term accept both ks while we fix publisher

tim: let's avoid loosening validation globally. prefer bringing JWKS up to date asap.

rene: I'm going to re-run publisher with debug flag, pushing rotated-key-v2 to jwks endpoint. Doing it now.

rene: ```
kubectl -n auth rollout restart deployment/key-publisher
kubectl logs deploy/key-publisher -c publisher --since=5m
# found configmap mismatch, fixing and re-applying
kubectl apply -f ci/rotations/9876/key-config.yaml
```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty: PAGER-8231 acknowledged by bob

pagerduty: Escalation policy: secondary alerted

rene: pushed new JWKS entry. curl https://auth.internal.redwood/jwks.json returns rotated-key-v2 now.

bob: validating — running a quick token verify against canary validator

bob: ```
$ curl -s https://auth.internal.redwood/verify -d '{"token":"<example-rotated-token>"}'
{"status":"ok","claims":{"sub":"svc-123","kid":"rotated-key-v2"}}
```

bob: rolling restart of auth-validators in us-west-2 canary pool

tim: monitor metrics: set a temporary graph on #prod-metrics for auth.validator.errors and 2xx/401s

incident-bot: :rotating_light: alert resolved: error rate dropped below threshold for 5m — auto-closed PAGER-8231

bob: marking incident as mitigated. next steps: (1) full rollback verification of rotation job, (2) postmortem, (3) adjust healthchecks on publisher to fail early on config mismatch

leanne: support: share customer impact list with CS, issuing guidance to customers to retry tokens, update docs for token rotation timeline

alice: thanks team. I'll own postmortem and include timeline, root cause (publisher didn't push JWKS due to config typo), and remediation steps: stricter CI validation, rollout gating, and canary alerts for JWKS drift

rene: adding follow-up: add automated test to rotation pipeline that curl's jwks and checks for expected kid

bob: leaving final ack, closing loop. :thumbsup:
